name: H-Power plc
summary: H-Power plc specializes in the advancement of fuel cell technology. The company's core mission involves the end-to-end management—from installation to ongoing operation and maintenance—of stationary alkaline systems. These systems are engineered to deliver reliable, fuel-efficient power solutions designed to meet future energy demands. Established by Howard White in January 2006, H-Power plc maintains its principal operations from its headquarters in Cranleigh, United Kingdom.
